risks.mitigation: Internal runtime and declaration dependencies are bundled into the three approved packages and verified with a registry-shaped clean install using only public targets.
risks.userImpact: Installing any of the three approved npm packages from the public registry would fail because required private @fuzit packages are unavailable.
risks.supportBoundary: The public proof packs only the three approved npm targets and installs them offline outside the monorepo.

risks.mitigation: Run the complete packed-artifact clean-room suite on a genuine native Ubuntu host.
risks.userImpact: Native Ubuntu behavior cannot be claimed or supported for publication.
risks.supportBoundary: WSL, containers, emulation, and hosted runners do not satisfy native Ubuntu evidence.

risks.mitigation: Run the complete packed-artifact clean-room suite on a genuine native macOS host.
risks.userImpact: Native macOS behavior cannot be claimed or supported for publication.
risks.supportBoundary: Only execution on a genuine native macOS host satisfies this gate.

risks.mitigation: Verify owner control of approved npm identities before authorization.
risks.userImpact: Approved npm package identities cannot be published safely.
risks.supportBoundary: No npm publication or identity rename occurs without owner-controlled access.

risks.mitigation: Verify owner control of the configured Marketplace publisher.
risks.userImpact: The VS Code extension cannot be distributed through the Marketplace.
risks.supportBoundary: Private VSIX verification does not establish publisher control.

risks.mitigation: Obtain name, trademark, publisher, and visual-asset clearance.
risks.userImpact: Public branding and distribution cannot proceed without clearance.
risks.supportBoundary: Technical use of the name and logo is not a legal-clearance claim.

risks.mitigation: Obtain explicit owner authorization for the exact release action.
risks.userImpact: No irreversible release action may execute.
risks.supportBoundary: Dry-runs and private pushes are preparation, never publication authorization.

risks.mitigation: Keep dynamic, generated, annotation-processing, reflection, and toolchain claims explicitly unsupported.
risks.userImpact: Some dynamic Java and Go relationships may be omitted or partial.
risks.supportBoundary: V1 promises bounded static analysis only, without native toolchain execution.

risks.mitigation: Treat recorded timings as environment-specific evidence and enforce only resource and relative incremental bounds.
risks.userImpact: Recorded wall-clock timings may differ on other hosts.
risks.supportBoundary: Resource limits and relative incremental behavior are supported; absolute timing is not.

risks.mitigation: Do not generalize Windows results to native Linux or macOS; retain both platform blockers.
risks.userImpact: Windows success alone does not establish Linux or macOS support.
risks.supportBoundary: Only native Windows is currently evidenced; other native platforms remain blocked.
